name: chronicle-gate-online
description: Chronicle Gate: seven Korean TRPG chronicles, 28 professions, 1–4 players, lightweight media and a Supabase-independent default game server.

scripts.verify: npm run clean:media && npm run check && npm test
scripts.test:integration: node tests-v16/network.integration.mjs && node tests-v16/combat-network.integration.mjs && node tests-v16/server.integration.mjs && node tests-v16/deployment.integration.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run verify && npm run test:ui && npm run test:integration
scripts.build:audio: python scripts/build-audio.py && python scripts/build-combat-audio.py && python scripts/optimize-audio.py && npm run clean:media
